evals.prompt: Export the stm32node board for JLCPCB with assembly.
evals.expected_output: Runs DRC first and refuses while the board is unrouted (67 unconnected); explains what is missing; after the user overrides, runs kcs fab --fab jlcpcb, lists the zip, pos and bom files, warns about missing LCSC numbers on passives and about rotation checks.
